title: Refuse or refresh a stale project envelope when the explicit task-sync step admits a merged data commit, so a new host can join it
outcome: Refuse or refresh a stale project envelope when the explicit task-sync step admits a merged data commit, so a new host can join it
acceptance: The explicit `task-sync step` resolution request either refuses, by name, a merged data commit whose embedded .engram/project.json inventory is stale, or publishes it only with a checked derived refresh; a test shows that every commit the step path can publish is accepted by strict initial import on a fresh host
